About Me

The designer behind the work — part strategist, part visual storyteller.

Mohamed Nagieb — Senior Graphic Designer

I'm Mohamed Nagieb, a Senior Graphic Designer with 8+ years of experience turning ideas into bold, memorable visual identities. I specialise in branding, logo design, visual identity, social media design and packaging — the complete visual language a brand needs to be seen, remembered and trusted.

Great design is never decoration. Every project starts with strategy: understanding the brand, its audience and its ambition, then crafting visuals that connect brands with people and drive real results — more recognition, more engagement, and a presence competitors can't ignore. From a single logo to a full identity system and scroll-stopping social content, I build design that works as hard as it looks.

Over the past eight years I've partnered with agencies and businesses across Egypt, Jordan and beyond — currently with La Vie Group and Bosla Technology, and previously with Sarri Telecom, DesignNest and Visionary Designs. That journey has earned the trust of 240+ clients across industries, from cafés and beauty brands to tech, logistics and home living.

I'm Adobe and Google certified, obsessed with craft and detail, and known for clean, confident work delivered with a premium finish. If you're building a brand — or rebuilding one — I'll help you say it visually, loudly and beautifully.
